item.title: How do you guys recover from 10-20 sets a week?

But now I am understanding recovery more and it’s actually half the reason I just could never keep myself lifting all this time. item.title: How do you guys recover from 10-20 sets a week?
item.description: Well the problem is I feel like shit outside of the gym if I do 2 sets to failure on everything. I can do the workout fine (if I can muster up the motivation through the burnout) but I don’t want to do it if it’s going to make me feel like crap and also stop me from recovering/progressing.

item.title: Fitness Advice for 5’7” 155 lbs Slightly Solid Lean Build
item.description: You need to build muscle, point blank. Find a program you can recover from while eating around maintenance and gain as much muscle as possible. Don’t skip lower body, as that will put on a ton of muscle. RDLs, Leg curls and Leg extensions is what I do (because I hate squatting). You’re 5’7, 155lbs around 25% bodyfat which puts you right at average FFMI. item.title: 🦉 Night Owls and Early Birds... Or Nonsense?
item.description: Yeah, I can’t relate to people that say “But what will I do when I’m retired?”. I absolutely love my days when I have whole day to do what I want. Relax with coffee Train Walk Coffee shop/read Farmer’s market Walk/hike on a trail or the beach Prep for dinner/shop Relax with the family Can’t beat that, and there’s no zoom meetings, overly sensitive colleagues, emails, reports, etc…
